title: Finding Peace in Prayer After a Hard Day
paragraphs: Setelah rapat yang penuh tekanan di mana usulannya ditolak di depan seluruh tim, Yusuf merasa malu dan frustrasi sepanjang sore itu, memutar ulang momen itu berulang kali dalam pikirannya.

Ketika Maghrib tiba, ia hampir melewatkan shalatnya, masih terlalu kesal untuk fokus dengan baik, tapi ia memaksakan diri untuk berhenti dan tetap shalat, berharap itu bisa menenangkan pikirannya yang berpacu.

Berdiri dengan tenang dalam shalat, jauh dari ponsel dan rekan kerjanya, Yusuf perlahan merasa frustrasinya melunak, digantikan perasaan yang lebih tenang dan menerima tentang hari yang mengecewakan itu.
Ia tidak tiba-tiba berhenti peduli tentang usulan yang ditolak, tapi ketajaman frustrasinya terlihat memudar saat ia selesai shalat malam itu.
Yusuf kemudian memberi tahu istrinya bahwa shalat tidak menghapus masalahnya, tapi memberinya cukup ketenangan untuk memikirkan presentasi besok tanpa kepahitan yang sama yang ia rasakan sebelumnya.
answerKey: After a stressful meeting where his proposal was rejected in front of the whole team, Yusuf felt embarrassed and frustrated for the rest of the afternoon, replaying the moment repeatedly in his mind. When Maghrib arrived, he almost skipped his prayer, still too irritated to focus properly, but he forced himself to stop and pray anyway, hoping it might calm his racing thoughts. Standing quietly in prayer, away from his phone and his coworkers, Yusuf slowly felt his frustration soften, replaced by a calmer, more accepting feeling about the disappointing day. He did not suddenly stop caring about the rejected proposal, but the sharp edge of his frustration had noticeably faded by the time he finished praying that evening. Yusuf later told his wife that prayer did not erase his problem, but it gave him enough calm to think about tomorrow's presentation without the same bitterness he felt earlier.
